CustomField.label: Stock Quantity
CustomField.description: Units currently available to sell. Blank means stock isn't tracked for this product yet — checkout treats a blank value as unlimited/always available rather than blocking the sale, the same graceful-fallback approach already used for Price__c/GST_Rate__c. Once set, CheckoutController enforces it with a row lock (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE) so two concurrent checkouts for the last unit can never both succeed, decrements it on a successful order, and OrderTrackingService restores it when an order is Cancelled or Returned.
